Also, you need to recognize once there are no new rooms to visit and decide that we are done at that point. To stop the exploration, answer with "DONE" instead. Omit any other text.

You have made a step and entered a Lobby. Currently available directions: east, north. What is your next instruction?
GO: north
...

DONE
